name: Arms for the Field
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for additional weapons that we haven't been able to provide at the moment.  Obtain the weapons they've requested and bring them to Merok Longstride outside of Hive'Regal.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Massive Iron Axes to Merok Longstride at the Orgrimmar Legion camp outside of Hive'Regal.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent work. We were in short supply of these, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something for me, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VI
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VI
